name: Hornero Forge Board
description: CI and pull-request status for the GitHub repositories you name, through the gh CLI session you already signed in. Read-only; stores and sees no token.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Use Theme.palette.inkMuted instead of inkFaint on readable text for Signal contrast
Guard stepDone state against missing current item and polish GitHub status copy
Gate refresh and one-shot timers on visible/active state.
Header no longer claims CI GREEN when gh is missing or signed out.
Initial release: latest workflow run per repository and your open pull requests with check state, via the gh CLI session. No token handling.

repositories.description: GitHub repositories as owner/name separated by spaces, commas or semicolons. Empty requests nothing.

maxRepositories.description: How many listed repositories to query (two gh calls each per refresh).

refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between refreshes. Requests pause in the Gaming experience.

showPullRequests.description: Also list your open pull requests (author: you) with review and check state.

maxPullRequests.description: Most pull requests shown per repository.
